slides.title: And in Sweden?
slides.body:
In Sweden you'll often hear the buffet named after the holiday: a *julbord* at Christmas, a *påskbord* at Easter.

A *smörgås* on its own is an open sandwich.

slides.en: We're having the Christmas buffet with the whole family.

caption:
Smörgåsbord is Swedish: a smörgås is an open sandwich, and bord means table. Take smörgås apart and it even says butter goose.

At Christmas, the big Swedish buffet is a julbord: a Yule table.

What would be on your smörgåsbord?
